summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and in core-shell, sub-route-billing, sub-route-reports in one PR (#1), merged, CI+CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time, so no registry release or dependency bump is needed; I bumped its package.json to 2.0.0 as a breaking-change marker. One PR since the lib and consumers must land together. Reports app isn't listed in docs as a CD-deployed component; its build passes.
